PR #3832 main integration: the requested CI checks reproduced two #3824-owned issues after retaining main CI fixes: a hand-written MCP fixture entry guard and fixture-only path reads. The fixture now uses invokedDirectly; the two suites are explicitly classified as captured-data/temp-file readers, with no source pin or scanner algorithm removed. Real MCP ping/blocked inventory and fixture startup passed alongside both policy suites (116 tests). Existing delivery limits and prose remain accurate. All conflicted runtime/test/prose/manifest deltas still match the original #3824 delta; the record was regenerated from main plus 14 probe-source links. No live-provider qualification.
